timing_verdict.label: NEUTRAL
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: NEUTRAL timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1400-1500 KRW/USD

WHY: The won has strengthened (weakened to 1400s) due to SK Hynix's ADR success and Korean-Japanese authorities' coordination, making dollars cheaper to buy right now. However, news outlets show conflicting outlooks—some expect the won to strengthen further to 1400 levels, while others warn of potential weakness toward 1800, and Middle East risks add uncertainty to the trend.

TIP: Given the volatility and mixed signals, maintain your fixed $2,000 monthly conversion schedule rather than trying to time the market—dollar-cost averaging will smooth out the strong/weak won swings over time.
